answer: To resist sybil attacks, each food-provenance agent must stake a bonded deposit tied to a verified cold-chain ledger, so identities cannot multiply without locking real capital like meltwater trapped in a glacier. Auditors then wander across the supply graph sampling custody handoffs, and any duplicate node claiming the same oasis of warehouse capacity is flagged through. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
